ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ وَٱلنُّورَ ثُمَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ يَعْدِلُونَ
en: (1) [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, who created the heavens and the earth and made the darkness and the light. Then those who disbelieve equate [others] with their Lord.
tr: Al-ḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wajaʿalaẓ-ẓulumāti wan-nūr, thummal-ladhīna kafarū birabbihim yaʿdilūn

ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن طِينٍ ثُمَّ قَضَىٰٓ أَجَلًا وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى عِندَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تَمْتَرُونَ
en: (2) It is He who created you from clay and then decreed a term[291] and a specified time [known] to Him;[292] then [still] you are in dispute.
enNotes:
[291]- An appointed time for death.
[292]- For resurrection.
tr: Huwal-ladhī khalaqakum min ṭīnin thumma qaḍā ajalā, waʾajalum musamman ʿindahū thumma antum tamtarūn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَعْلَمُ سِرَّكُمْ وَجَهْرَكُمْ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُونَ
en: (3) And He is Allāh, [the only deity] in the heavens and the earth. He knows your secret and what you make public, and He knows that which you earn.
tr: Wahuwallāhu fis-samāwāti wafil-arḍ, yaʿlamu sirrakum wajahrakum wayaʿlamu mā taksibūn

ar: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
en: (4) And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they turn away therefrom.
tr: Wamā taʾtīhim min āyatim min āyāti rabbihim illā kānū ʿanhā muʿriḍīn

ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: (5) For they had denied the truth when it came to them, but there is going to reach them the news of what they used to ridicule.[293]
enNotes: [293]- They will experience the reality of what they had denied and the consequence of their denial.
tr: Faqad kadhdhabū bil-ḥaqqi lammā jāʾahum, fasawfa yaʾtīhim ambāʾu mā kānū bihī yastahziʾūn

ar: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمْ وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْهِم مِّدْرَارًا وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
en: (6) Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them which We had established upon the earth as We have not established you? And We sent [rain from] the sky upon them in showers and made rivers flow beneath them; then We destroyed them for their sins and brought forth after them a generation of others.
tr: Alam yaraw kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnim makkannāhum fil-arḍi mā lam numakkil lakum waʾarsalnas-samāʾa ʿalayhim midrārā, wajaʿalnal-anhāra tajrī min taḥtihim faʾahlaknāhum bidhunūbihim waʾanshaʾnā mim baʿdihim qarnan ākharīn

ar: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ كِتَٰبًا فِى قِرْطَاسٍ فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ لَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (7) And even if We had sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], a written scripture on a page and they touched it with their hands, the disbelievers would say, "This is not but obvious magic."
tr: Walaw nazzalnā ʿalayka kitāban fī qirṭāsin falamasūhu biʾaydīhim laqālal-ladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā siḥrum mubīn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ وَلَوْ أَنزَلْنَا مَلَكًا لَّقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنظَرُونَ
en: (8) And they say, "Why was there not sent down to him an angel?"[294] But if We had sent down an angel, the matter would have been decided;[295] then they would not be reprieved.
enNotes:
[294]- In support of his prophethood (ﷺ).
[295]- They would have been destroyed immediately with no chance for repentance.
tr: Waqālū lawlā unzila ʿalayhi malak, walaw anzalnā malakal laquḍiyal-amru thumma lā yunẓarūn

ar: وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَٰهُ مَلَكًا لَّجَعَلْنَٰهُ رَجُلًا وَلَلَبَسْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّا يَلْبِسُونَ
en: (9) And if We had made him [i.e., the messenger] an angel, We would have made him [appear as] a man, and We would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves [i.e., confusion and doubt].
tr: Walaw jaʿalnāhu malakal lajaʿalnāhu rajulaw walalabasnā ʿalayhim mā yalbisūn

ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: (10) And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by that which they used to ridicule.
tr: Walaqadistuhziʾa birusulim min qablika faḥāqa bil-ladhīna sakhirū minhum mā kānū bihī yastahziʾūn

ar: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
en: (11) Say, "Travel through the land; then observe how was the end of the deniers."
tr: Qul sīrū fil-arḍi thummanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatul-mukadhdhibīn

ar: قُل لِّمَن مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ قُل لِّلَّهِ كَتَبَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ لَيَجْمَعَنَّكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (12) Say, "To whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth?" Say, "To Allāh." He has decreed upon Himself mercy. He will surely assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt. Those who will lose themselves [that Day] do not believe.
tr: Qul limam mā fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ, qul lillāh, kataba ʿalā nafsihir-raḥmah, layajmaʿannakum ilā yawmil-qiyāmati lā rayba fīh, alladhīna khasirū anfusahum fahum lā yuʾminūn

ar: وَلَهُۥ مَا سَكَنَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (13) And to Him belongs that which reposes by night and by day, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr: Walahū mā sakana fil-layli wan-nahār, wahuwas-samīʿul-ʿalīm

ar: قُلْ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيًّا فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ يُطْعِمُ وَلَا يُطْعَمُ قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
en: (14) Say, "Is it other than Allāh I should take as a protector, Creator of the heavens and earth, while it is He who feeds and is not fed?" Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to be the first [among you] who submit [to Allāh] and [was commanded], 'Do not ever be of the polytheists.'"
tr: Qul aghayrallāhi attakhidhu waliyyan fāṭiris-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa yuṭʿimu walā yuṭʿam, qul innī umirtu an akūna awwala man aslama walā takūnanna minal-mushrikīn

ar: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
en: (15) Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
tr: Qul innī akhāfu in ʿaṣaytu rabbī ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīm

ar: مَّن يُصْرَفْ عَنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمَهُۥ وَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
en: (16) He from whom it is averted that Day - [Allāh] has granted him mercy. And that is the clear attainment.
tr: May yuṣraf ʿanhu yawmaʾidhin faqad raḥimah, wadhālikal-fawzul-mubīn

ar: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُۥٓ إِلَّا هُوَ وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: (17) And if Allāh should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him. And if He touches you with good - then He is over all things competent.
tr: Waʾiy yamsaskallāhu biḍurrin falā kāshifa lahū illā huw, waʾiy yamsaska bikhayrin fahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
en: (18) And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise,[296] the Aware.[297]
enNotes:
[296]- Whose wisdom includes precise, perfect and absolute knowledge of all realities and outcomes, according to which He decrees and causes circumstances and occurrences.
[297]- Fully acquainted and familiar with every hidden thought, intent and condition of His servants.
tr: Wahuwal-qāhiru fawqa ʿibādih, wahuwal-ḥakīmul-khabīr

ar: قُلْ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهَٰدَةً قُلِ ٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌۢ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَأُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لِأُنذِرَكُم بِهِۦ وَمَنۢ بَلَغَ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً أُخْرَىٰ قُل لَّآ أَشْهَدُ قُلْ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ وَإِنَّنِى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
en: (19) Say, "What thing is greatest in testimony?" Say, "Allāh is witness between me and you. And this Qur’ān was revealed to me that I may warn you thereby and whomever it reaches.[298] Do you [truly] testify that with Allāh there are other deities?" Say, "I will not testify [with you]." Say, "Indeed, He is but one God, and indeed, I am free of what you associate [with Him]."
enNotes: [298]- At every time and place until the Day of Judgement.
tr: Qul ayyu shayʾin akbaru shahādah, qulillāh, shahīdum baynī wabaynakum, waʾūḥiya ilayya hādhal-qurʾānu liʾundhirakum bihī wamam balagh, aʾinnakum latashhadūna anna maʿallāhi ālihatan ukhrā, qul lā ashhad, qul innamā huwa ilāhuw wāḥiduw waʾinnanī barīʾum mimmā tushrikūn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَعْرِفُونَهُۥ كَمَا يَعْرِفُونَ أَبْنَآءَهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (20) Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize it[299] as they recognize their [own] sons. Those who will lose themselves [in the Hereafter] do not believe.
enNotes: [299]- The Qur’ān. Also interpreted as "him," meaning Muḥammad (ﷺ).
tr: Alladhīna ātaynāhumul-kitāba yaʿrifūnahū kamā yaʿrifūna abnāʾahum, alladhīna khasirū anfusahum fahum lā yuʾminūn

ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
en: (21) And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh a lie or denies His verses? Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed.
tr: Waman aẓlamu mimmaniftarā ʿalallāhi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba biʾāyātih, innahū lā yufliḥuẓ-ẓālimūn

ar: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓا۟ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآؤُكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
en: (22) And [mention, O Muḥammad], the Day We will gather them all together; then We will say to those who associated others with Allāh, "Where are your 'partners' that you used to claim [with Him]?"
tr: Wayawma naḥshuruhum jamīʿan thumma naqūlu lilladhīna ashrakū ayna shurakāʾukumul-ladhīna kuntum tazʿumūn

ar: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَكُن فِتْنَتُهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ وَٱللَّهِ رَبِّنَا مَا كُنَّا مُشْرِكِينَ
en: (23) Then there will be no [excuse upon] examination except they will say, "By Allāh, our Lord, we were not those who associated."
tr: Thumma lam takun fitnatuhum illā an qālū wallāhi rabbinā mā kunnā mushrikīn

ar: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
en: (24) See how they will lie about themselves. And lost from them will be what they used to invent.
tr: Unẓur kayfa kadhabū ʿalā anfusihim waḍalla ʿanhum mā kānū yaftarūn

ar: وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كُلَّ ءَايَةٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوكَ يُجَٰدِلُونَكَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
en: (25) And among them are those who listen to you,[300] but We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. Even when they come to you arguing with you, those who disbelieve say, "This is not but legends of the former peoples."
enNotes: [300]- When you recite the Qur’ān.
tr: Waminhum may yastamiʿu ilayk, wajaʿalnā ʿalā qulūbihim akinnatan ay yafqahūhu wafī ādhānihim waqrā, waʾiy yaraw kulla āyatil lā yuʾminū bihā, ḥattā idhā jāʾūka yujādilūnaka yaqūlul-ladhīna kafarū in hādhā illā asāṭīrul-awwalīn

ar: وَهُمْ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ وَيَنْـَٔوْنَ عَنْهُ وَإِن يُهْلِكُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
en: (26) And they prevent [others] from him and are [themselves] remote from him. And they do not destroy except themselves, but they perceive [it] not.
tr: Wahum yanhawna ʿanhu wayanʾawna ʿanh, waʾiy yuhlikūna illā anfusahum wamā yashʿurūn

ar: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ وُقِفُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَقَالُوا۟ يَٰلَيْتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (27) If you could but see when they are made to stand before the Fire and will say, "Oh, would that we could be returned [to life on earth] and not deny the signs of our Lord and be among the believers."
tr: Walaw tarā idh wuqifū ʿalan-nāri faqālū yālaytanā nuraddu walā nukadhdhiba biʾāyāti rabbinā wanakūna minal-muʾminīn

ar: بَلْ بَدَا لَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُخْفُونَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَوْ رُدُّوا۟ لَعَادُوا۟ لِمَا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
en: (28) But what they concealed before has [now] appeared to them. And even if they were returned, they would return to that which they were forbidden; and indeed, they are liars.
tr: Bal badā lahum mā kānū yukhfūna min qabl, walaw ruddū laʿādū limā nuhū ʿanhu waʾinnahum lakādhibūn

ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
en: (29) And they say, "There is none but our worldly life, and we will not be resurrected."
tr: Waqālū in hiya illā ḥayātunad-dunyā wamā naḥnu bimabʿūthīn

ar: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ وُقِفُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ هَٰذَا بِٱلْحَقِّ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا قَالَ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
en: (30) If you could but see when they will be made to stand before their Lord. He will say, "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will [then] say, "So taste the punishment for what you used to deny."
tr: Walaw tarā idh wuqifū ʿalā rabbihim, qāla alaysa hādhā bil-ḥaqq, qālū balā warabbinā, qāla fadhūqul-ʿadhāba bimā kuntum takfurūn

ar: قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً قَالُوا۟ يَٰحَسْرَتَنَا عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِيهَا وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزَارَهُمْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِمْ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
en: (31) Those will have lost who deny the meeting with Allāh, until when the Hour [of resurrection] comes upon them unexpectedly, they will say, "Oh, [how great is] our regret over what we neglected concerning it [i.e., the Hour]," while they bear their burdens [i.e., sins] on their backs. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.
tr: Qad khasiral-ladhīna kadhdhabū biliqāʾillāh, ḥattā idhā jāʾathumus-sāʿatu baghtatan qālū yāḥasratanā ʿalā mā farraṭnā fīhā wahum yaḥmilūna awzārahum ʿalā ẓuhūrihim, alā sāʾa mā yazirūn

ar: وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَلَلدَّارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
en: (32) And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh, so will you not reason?
tr: Wamal-ḥayātud-dunyā illā laʿibuw walahw, walad-dārul-ākhiratu khayrul lilladhīna yattaqūn, afalā taʿqilūn

ar: قَدْ نَعْلَمُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيَحْزُنُكَ ٱلَّذِى يَقُولُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
en: (33) We know that you, [O Muḥammad], are saddened by what they say. And indeed, they do not call you untruthful, but it is the verses of Allāh that the wrongdoers reject.
tr: Qad naʿlamu innahū layaḥzunukal-ladhī yaqūlūna faʾinnahum lā yukadhdhibūnaka walākinnaẓ-ẓālimīna biʾāyātillāhi yajḥadūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَصَبَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا كُذِّبُوا۟ وَأُوذُوا۟ حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰهُمْ نَصْرُنَا وَلَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكَ مِن نَّبَإِى۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
en: (34) And certainly were messengers denied before you, but they were patient over the denial, and they were harmed until Our victory came to them. And none can alter the words [i.e., decrees] of Allāh. And there has certainly come to you some information about the [previous] messengers.
tr: Walaqad kudhdhibat rusulum min qablika faṣabarū ʿalā mā kudhdhibū waʾūdhū ḥattā atāhum naṣrunā, walā mubaddila likalimātillāh, walaqad jāʾaka min nabaʾil-mursalīn

ar: وَإِن كَانَ كَبُرَ عَلَيْكَ إِعْرَاضُهُمْ فَإِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ أَن تَبْتَغِىَ نَفَقًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَوْ سُلَّمًا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتَأْتِيَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَمَعَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
en: (35) And if their evasion is difficult for you, then if you are able to seek a tunnel into the earth or a stairway into the sky to bring them a sign, [then do so]. But if Allāh had willed, He would have united them upon guidance. So never be of the ignorant.
tr: Waʾin kāna kabura ʿalayka iʿrāḍuhum faʾinistaṭaʿta an tabtaghiya nafaqan fil-arḍi aw sullaman fis-samāʾi fataʾtiyahum biʾāyah, walaw shāʾallāhu lajamaʿahum ʿalal-hudā falā takūnanna minal-jāhilīn

ar: إِنَّمَا يَسْتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْمَعُونَ وَٱلْمَوْتَىٰ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ
en: (36) Only those who hear will respond. But the dead[301] - Allāh will resurrect them; then to Him they will be returned.
enNotes: [301]- i.e., the dead of heart, meaning the disbelievers.
tr: Innamā yastajībul-ladhīna yasmaʿūn, wal-mawtā yabʿathuhumullāhu thumma ilayhi yurjaʿūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُنَزِّلَ ءَايَةً وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (37) And they say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, "Indeed, Allāh is Able to send down a sign, but most of them do not know."
tr: Waqālū lawlā nuzzila ʿalayhi āyatum mir rabbih, qul innallāha qādirun ʿalā ay yunazzila āyataw walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūn

ar: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا طَٰٓئِرٍ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيْهِ إِلَّآ أُمَمٌ أَمْثَالُكُم مَّا فَرَّطْنَا فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِن شَىْءٍ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُونَ
en: (38) And there is no creature on [or within] the earth or bird that flies with its wings except [that they are] communities like you. We have not neglected in the Register[302] a thing. Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.
enNotes: [302]- The Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ), in which all things are recorded.
tr: Wamā min dābbatin fil-arḍi walā ṭāʾiriy yaṭīru bijanāḥayhi illā umamun amthālukum, mā farraṭnā fil-kitābi min shayʾin thumma ilā rabbihim yuḥsharūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا صُمٌّ وَبُكْمٌ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ مَن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يُضْلِلْهُ وَمَن يَشَأْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
en: (39) But those who deny Our verses are deaf and dumb within darknesses. Whomever Allāh wills - He sends astray; and whomever He wills - He puts him on a straight path.
tr: Wal-ladhīna kadhdhabū biʾāyātinā ṣummuw wabukmun fiẓ-ẓulumāt, may yashaʾillāhu yuḍlilhu wamay yashaʾ yajʿalhu ʿalā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm

ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ أَتَتْكُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَدْعُونَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (40) Say, "Have you considered:[303] if there came to you the punishment of Allāh or there came to you the Hour - is it other than Allāh you would invoke, if you should be truthful?"
enNotes: [303]- The meaning is understood to be "Tell me..."
tr: Qul araʾaytakum in atākum ʿadhābullāhi aw atatkumus-sāʿatu aghayrallāhi tadʿūn, in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: بَلْ إِيَّاهُ تَدْعُونَ فَيَكْشِفُ مَا تَدْعُونَ إِلَيْهِ إِن شَآءَ وَتَنسَوْنَ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ
en: (41) No, it is Him [alone] you would invoke, and He would remove that for which you invoked Him if He willed, and you would forget what you associate [with Him].
tr: Bal iyyāhu tadʿūna fayakshifu mā tadʿūna ilayhi in shāʾa watansawna mā tushrikūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْبَأْسَآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
en: (42) And We have already sent [messengers] to nations before you, [O Muḥammad]; then We seized them with poverty and hardship that perhaps they might humble themselves [to Us].
tr: Walaqad arsalnā ilā umamim min qablika faʾakhadhnāhum bil-baʾsāʾi waḍ-ḍarrāʾi laʿallahum yataḍarraʿūn

ar: فَلَوْلَآ إِذْ جَآءَهُم بَأْسُنَا تَضَرَّعُوا۟ وَلَٰكِن قَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (43) Then why, when Our punishment came to them, did they not humble themselves? But their hearts became hardened, and Satan made attractive to them that which they were doing.
tr: Falawlā idh jāʾahum baʾsunā taḍarraʿū walākin qasat qulūbuhum wazayyana lahumush-shayṭānu mā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: فَلَمَّا نَسُوا۟ مَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَبْوَٰبَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَآ أُوتُوٓا۟ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بَغْتَةً فَإِذَا هُم مُّبْلِسُونَ
en: (44) So when they forgot that by which they had been reminded,[304] We opened to them the doors of every [good] thing until, when they rejoiced in that which they were given, We seized them suddenly, and they were [then] in despair.
enNotes: [304]- i.e., their trial by poverty and hardship or the warnings of their prophets.
tr: Falammā nasū mā dhukkirū bihī fataḥnā ʿalayhim abwāba kulli shayʾ, ḥattā idhā fariḥū bimā ūtū akhadhnāhum baghtatan faʾidhā hum mublisūn

ar: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (45) So the people that committed wrong were eliminated. And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
tr: Faquṭiʿa dābirul-qawmil-ladhīna ẓalamū, wal-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbil-ʿālamīn

ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ سَمْعَكُمْ وَأَبْصَٰرَكُمْ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُم مَّنْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِهِ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ ثُمَّ هُمْ يَصْدِفُونَ
en: (46) Say, "Have you considered:[305] if Allāh should take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal upon your hearts, which deity other than Allāh could bring them [back] to you?" Look how We diversify[306] the verses; then they [still] turn away.
enNotes:
[305]- See footnote to verse 40.
[306]- Repeat in various ways for emphasis and clarification.
tr: Qul araʾaytum in akhadhallāhu samʿakum waʾabṣārakum wakhatama ʿalā qulūbikum man ilāhun ghayrullāhi yaʾtīkum bih, unẓur kayfa nuṣarriful-āyāti thumma hum yaṣdifūn

ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتَكُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُ ٱللَّهِ بَغْتَةً أَوْ جَهْرَةً هَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا ٱلْقَوْمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
en: (47) Say, "Have you considered: if the punishment of Allāh should come to you unexpectedly or manifestly,[307] will any be destroyed but the wrongdoing people?"
enNotes: [307]- i.e., before your eyes.
tr: Qul araʾaytakum in atākum ʿadhābullāhi baghtatan aw jahratan hal yuhlaku illal-qawmuẓ-ẓālimūn

ar: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ فَمَنْ ءَامَنَ وَأَصْلَحَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
en: (48) And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. So whoever believes and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
tr: Wamā nursilul-mursalīna illā mubashshirīna wamundhirīn, faman āmana waʾaṣlaḥa falā khawfun ʿalayhim walā hum yaḥzanūn

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
en: (49) But those who deny Our verses - the punishment will touch[308] them for their defiant disobedience.
enNotes: [308]- i.e., reach and afflict.
tr: Wal-ladhīna kadhdhabū biʾāyātinā yamassuhumul-ʿadhābu bimā kānū yafsuqūn

ar: قُل لَّآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِى خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعْلَمُ ٱلْغَيْبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ إِنِّى مَلَكٌ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ أَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُونَ
en: (50) Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not tell you that I have the depositories [containing the provision] of Allāh or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me." Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Then will you not give thought?"
tr: Qul lā aqūlu lakum ʿindī khazāʾinullāhi walā aʿlamul-ghayba walā aqūlu lakum innī malak, in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayy, qul hal yastawil-aʿmā wal-baṣīr, afalā tatafakkarūn

ar: وَأَنذِرْ بِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَن يُحْشَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ لَيْسَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ وَلِىٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
en: (51) And warn by it [i.e., the Qur’ān] those who fear that they will be gathered before their Lord - for them besides Him will be no protector and no intercessor - that they might become righteous.
tr: Waʾandhir bihil-ladhīna yakhāfūna ay yuḥsharū ilā rabbihim laysa lahum min dūnihī waliyyuw walā shafīʿul laʿallahum yattaqūn

ar: وَلَا تَطْرُدِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلْعَشِىِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُۥ مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ وَمَا مِنْ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (52) And do not send away those who call upon their Lord morning and afternoon, seeking His face [i.e., favor]. Not upon you is anything of their account and not upon them is anything of your account.[309] So were you to send them away, you would [then] be of the wrongdoers.
enNotes: [309]- No one is held accountable for the deeds or intentions of another. That is left to Allāh's judgement.
tr: Walā taṭrudil-ladhīna yadʿūna rabbahum bil-ghadāti wal-ʿashiyyi yurīdūna wajhah, mā ʿalayka min ḥisābihim min shayʾiw wamā min ḥisābika ʿalayhim min shayʾin fataṭrudahum fatakūna minaẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لِّيَقُولُوٓا۟ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنۢ بَيْنِنَآ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
en: (53) And thus We have tried some of them through others that they [i.e., the disbelievers] might say, "Is it these whom Allāh has favored among us?" Is not Allāh most knowing of those who are grateful?[310]
enNotes: [310]- Those referred to in verses 52-54 are the poor Muslims who were sincere believers and students of the Prophet (ﷺ). The influential leaders of Quraysh had disdained to sit with them, saying to Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ), "Perhaps if you evicted them, we would follow you."
tr: Wakadhālika fatannā baʿḍahum bibaʿḍil liyaqūlū ahāʾulāʾi mannallāhu ʿalayhim mim bayninā, alaysallāhu biʾaʿlama bish-shākirīn

ar: وَإِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ أَنَّهُۥ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنكُمْ سُوٓءًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
en: (54) And when those come to you who believe in Our verses, say, "Peace be upon you. Your Lord has decreed upon Himself mercy: that any of you who does wrong out of ignorance and then repents after that and corrects himself - indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful."
tr: Waʾidhā jāʾakal-ladhīna yuʾminūna biʾāyātinā faqul salāmun ʿalaykum kataba rabbukum ʿalā nafsihir-raḥmata annahū man ʿamila minkum sūʾam bijahālatin thumma tāba mim baʿdihī waʾaṣlaḥa faʾannahū ghafūrur raḥīm

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
en: (55) And thus do We detail the verses, and [thus] the way of the criminals will become evident.
tr: Wakadhālika nufaṣṣilul-āyāti walitastabīna sabīlul-mujrimīn

ar: قُلْ إِنِّى نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قُل لَّآ أَتَّبِعُ أَهْوَآءَكُمْ قَدْ ضَلَلْتُ إِذًا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
en: (56) Say, "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you invoke besides Allāh." Say, "I will not follow your desires, for I would then have gone astray, and I would not be of the [rightly] guided."
tr: Qul innī nuhītu an aʿbudal-ladhīna tadʿūna min dūnillāh, qul lā attabiʿu ahwāʾakum qad ḍalaltu idhaw wamā ana minal-muhtadīn

ar: قُلْ إِنِّى عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّى وَكَذَّبْتُم بِهِۦ مَا عِندِى مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِنِ ٱلْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ يَقُصُّ ٱلْحَقَّ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْفَٰصِلِينَ
en: (57) Say, "Indeed, I am on clear evidence from my Lord, and you have denied it. I do not have that for which you are impatient.[311] The decision is only for Allāh. He relates the truth, and He is the best of deciders."
enNotes: [311]- The disbelievers would challenge the Prophet (ﷺ), telling him to bring on Allāh's punishment if he should be truthful in his warning.
tr: Qul innī ʿalā bayyinatim mir rabbī wakadhdhabtum bih, mā ʿindī mā tastaʿjilūna bih, inil-ḥukmu illā lillāh, yaquṣṣul-ḥaqqa wahuwa khayrul-fāṣilīn

ar: قُل لَّوْ أَنَّ عِندِى مَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِهِۦ لَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (58) Say, "If I had that for which you are impatient, the matter would have been decided between me and you, but Allāh is most knowing of the wrongdoers."
tr: Qul law anna ʿindī mā tastaʿjilūna bihī laquḍiyal-amru baynī wabaynakum, wallāhu aʿlamu biẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: وَعِندَهُۥ مَفَاتِحُ ٱلْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُهَآ إِلَّا هُوَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِن وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٍ فِى ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا رَطْبٍ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (59) And with Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him. And He knows what is on the land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but that He knows it. And no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry [thing] but that it is [written] in a clear record.
tr: Waʿindahū mafātiḥul-ghaybi lā yaʿlamuhā illā huw, wayaʿlamu mā fil-barri wal-baḥr, wamā tasquṭu miw waraqatin illā yaʿlamuhā walā ḥabbatin fī ẓulumātil-arḍi walā raṭbiw walā yābisin illā fī kitābim mubīn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُم بِٱلنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِيهِ لِيُقْضَىٰٓ أَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (60) And it is He who takes your souls by night[312] and knows what you have committed by day. Then He revives you therein [i.e., by day] that a specified term[313] may be fulfilled. Then to Him will be your return; then He will inform you about what you used to do.
enNotes:
[312]- i.e., when you sleep.
[313]- One's decreed life span.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī yatawaffākum bil-layli wayaʿlamu mā jaraḥtum bin-nahāri thumma yabʿathukum fīhi liyuqḍā ajalum musammā, thumma ilayhi marjiʿukum thumma yunabbiʾukum bimā kuntum taʿmalūn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيُرْسِلُ عَلَيْكُمْ حَفَظَةً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ تَوَفَّتْهُ رُسُلُنَا وَهُمْ لَا يُفَرِّطُونَ
en: (61) And He is the subjugator over His servants, and He sends over you guardian-angels until, when death comes to one of you, Our messengers [i.e., angels of death] take him, and they do not fail [in their duties].
tr: Wahuwal-qāhiru fawqa ʿibādihī wayursilu ʿalaykum ḥafaẓah, ḥattā idhā jāʾa aḥadakumul-mawtu tawaffathu rusulunā wahum lā yufarriṭūn

ar: ثُمَّ رُدُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوْلَىٰهُمُ ٱلْحَقِّ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلْحُكْمُ وَهُوَ أَسْرَعُ ٱلْحَٰسِبِينَ
en: (62) Then they [i.e., His servants] are returned to Allāh, their true Lord. Unquestionably, His is the judgement, and He is the swiftest of accountants.
tr: Thumma ruddū ilallāhi mawlāhumul-ḥaqq, alā lahul-ḥukmu wahuwa asraʿul-ḥāsibīn

ar: قُلْ مَن يُنَجِّيكُم مِّن ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ تَدْعُونَهُۥ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً لَّئِنْ أَنجَىٰنَا مِنْ هَٰذِهِۦ لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
en: (63) Say, "Who rescues you from the darknesses of the land and sea [when] you call upon Him imploring [aloud] and privately, 'If He should save us from this [crisis], we will surely be among the thankful.'"
tr: Qul may yunajjīkum min ẓulumātil-barri wal-baḥri tadʿūnahū taḍarruʿaw wakhufyah, laʾin anjānā min hādhihī lanakūnanna minash-shākirīn

ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُنَجِّيكُم مِّنْهَا وَمِن كُلِّ كَرْبٍ ثُمَّ أَنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ
en: (64) Say, "It is Allāh who saves you from it and from every distress; then you [still] associate others with Him."
tr: Qulillāhu yunajjīkum minhā wamin kulli karbin thumma antum tushrikūn

ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلْقَادِرُ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًا مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ أَوْ مِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًا وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُم بَأْسَ بَعْضٍ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَفْقَهُونَ
en: (65) Say, "He is the [one] Able to send upon you affliction from above you or from beneath your feet or to confuse you [so you become] sects[314] and make you taste the violence of one another." Look how We diversify the signs that they might understand.
enNotes: [314]- Following your own inclinations rather than the truth, biased and hostile toward each other.
tr: Qul huwal-qādiru ʿalā ay yabʿatha ʿalaykum ʿadhābam min fawqikum aw min taḥti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiyaʿaw wayudhīqa baʿḍakum baʾsa baʿḍ, unẓur kayfa nuṣarriful-āyāti laʿallahum yafqahūn

ar: وَكَذَّبَ بِهِۦ قَوْمُكَ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ قُل لَّسْتُ عَلَيْكُم بِوَكِيلٍ
en: (66) But your people have denied it while it is the truth. Say, "I am not over you a manager [i.e., authority]."
tr: Wakadhdhaba bihī qawmuka wahuwal-ḥaqq, qul lastu ʿalaykum biwakīl

ar: لِّكُلِّ نَبَإٍ مُّسْتَقَرٌّ وَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (67) For every news [i.e., happening] is a finality;[315] and you are going to know.
enNotes: [315]- Other shades of meaning include "a permanence," "a realization" and "a time of stability."
tr: Likulli nabaʾim mustaqarruw wasawfa taʿlamūn

ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَخُوضُوا۟ فِى حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِۦ وَإِمَّا يُنسِيَنَّكَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فَلَا تَقْعُدْ بَعْدَ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (68) And when you see those who engage in [offensive] discourse[316] concerning Our verses, then turn away from them until they enter into another conversation. And if Satan should cause you to forget, then do not remain after the reminder with the wrongdoing people.
enNotes: [316]- i.e., denials or mockery.
tr: Waʾidhā raʾaytal-ladhīna yakhūḍūna fī āyātinā faʾaʿriḍ ʿanhum ḥattā yakhūḍū fī ḥadīthin ghayrih, waʾimmā yunsiyannakash-shayṭānu falā taqʿud baʿdadh-dhikrā maʿal-qawmiẓ-ẓālimīn

ar: وَمَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ وَلَٰكِن ذِكْرَىٰ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
en: (69) And those who fear Allāh are not held accountable for them [i.e., the disbelievers] at all, but [only for] a reminder - that perhaps they will fear Him.
tr: Wamā ʿalal-ladhīna yattaqūna min ḥisābihim min shayʾiw walākin dhikrā laʿallahum yattaqūn

ar: وَذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ لَعِبًا وَلَهْوًا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَذَكِّرْ بِهِۦٓ أَن تُبْسَلَ نَفْسٌۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِىٌّ وَلَا شَفِيعٌ وَإِن تَعْدِلْ كُلَّ عَدْلٍ لَّا يُؤْخَذْ مِنْهَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُبْسِلُوا۟ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَرَابٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ
en: (70) And leave those who take their religion as amusement and diversion and whom the worldly life has deluded. But remind with it [i.e., the Qur’ān], lest a soul be given up to destruction for what it earned; it will have other than Allāh no protector and no intercessor. And if it should offer every compensation, it would not be taken from it [i.e., that soul]. Those are the ones who are given to destruction for what they have earned. For them will be a drink of scalding water and a painful punishment because they used to disbelieve.
tr: Wadharil-ladhīnattakhadhū dīnahum laʿibaw walahwaw wagharrathumul-ḥayātud-dunyā wadhakkir bihī an tubsala nafsum bimā kasabat, laysa lahā min dūnillāhi waliyyuw walā shafīʿ, waʾin taʿdil kulla ʿadlil lā yuʾkhadh minhā, ulāʾikal-ladhīna ubsilū bimā kasabū lahum sharābum min ḥamīmiw waʿadhābun alīmum bimā kānū yakfurūn

ar: قُلْ أَنَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُنَا وَلَا يَضُرُّنَا وَنُرَدُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَابِنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ كَٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَهْوَتْهُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ حَيْرَانَ لَهُۥٓ أَصْحَٰبٌ يَدْعُونَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَى ٱئْتِنَا قُلْ إِنَّ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ هُوَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَأُمِرْنَا لِنُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (71) Say, "Shall we invoke[317] instead of Allāh that which neither benefits us nor harms us and be turned back on our heels after Allāh has guided us? [We would then be] like one whom the devils enticed [to wander] upon the earth confused, [while] he has companions inviting him to guidance, [calling], 'Come to us.'"[318] Say, "Indeed, the guidance of Allāh is the [only] guidance; and we have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds.
enNotes:
[317]- i.e., worship.
[318]- The example given is of one who has lost his way and is further confused by the evil ones who tempt him to follow various directions, all leading to destruction. Although his sincere friends call him back to the right path, he ignores them.
tr: Qul anadʿū min dūnillāhi mā lā yanfaʿunā walā yaḍurrunā wanuraddu ʿalā aʿqābinā baʿda idh hadānallāhu kal-ladhistahwathush-shayāṭīnu fil-arḍi ḥayrāna lahū aṣḥābuy yadʿūnahū ilal-hudaʾtinā, qul inna hudallāhi huwal-hudā, waʾumirnā linuslima lirabbil-ʿālamīn

ar: وَأَنْ أَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
en: (72) And to establish prayer and fear Him." And it is He to whom you will be gathered.
tr: Waʾan aqīmuṣ-ṣalāta wattaqūh, wahuwal-ladhī ilayhi tuḥsharūn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ كُن فَيَكُونُ قَوْلُهُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
en: (73) And it is He who created the heavens and earth in truth. And the day [i.e., whenever] He says, "Be," and it is, His word is the truth.[319] And His is the dominion [on] the Day the Horn is blown. [He is] Knower of the unseen[320] and the witnessed;[321] and He is the Wise, the Aware.
enNotes:
[319]- When interpreted as the "Day" (of resurrection), the sentence would read: "And the Day He says, 'Be,' and it is, His word will be the truth."
[320]- That which is absent, invisible, or beyond the perception of the senses or of the mind and therefore is unknown to man, except for what Allāh chooses to reveal.
[321]- What is present, visible and known to man. The knowledge of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) includes the reality of all things and all occurrences, no matter how they might appear to human beings.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqq, wayawma yaqūlu kun fayakūn, qawluhul-ḥaqq, walahul-mulku yawma yunfakhu fiṣ-ṣūr, ʿālimul-ghaybi wash-shahādati wahuwal-ḥakīmul-khabīr

ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ ءَازَرَ أَتَتَّخِذُ أَصْنَامًا ءَالِهَةً إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكَ وَقَوْمَكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (74) And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father Āzar, "Do you take idols as deities? Indeed, I see you and your people to be in manifest error."
tr: Waʾidh qāla ibrāhīmu liʾabīhi āzara atattakhidhu aṣnāman ālihah, innī arāka waqawmaka fī ḍalālim mubīn

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
en: (75) And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith].
tr: Wakadhālika nurī ibrāhīma malakūtas-samāwāti wal-arḍi waliyakūna minal-mūqinīn

ar: فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلَّيْلُ رَءَا كَوْكَبًا قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّى فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَآ أُحِبُّ ٱلْـَٔافِلِينَ
en: (76) So when the night covered him [with darkness], he saw a star. He said, "This is my lord."[322] But when it set, he said, "I like not those that set [i.e., disappear]."
enNotes: [322]- In verses 76-79, beginning from the people's own assertions, Abraham presents a picture of his dissatisfaction as the only logical conclusion one could reach, in order to show them the futility of their false objects of worship.
tr: Falammā janna ʿalayhil-laylu raʾā kawkabā, qāla hādhā rabbī, falammā afala qāla lā uḥibbul-āfilīn

ar: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلْقَمَرَ بَازِغًا قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّى فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَئِن لَّمْ يَهْدِنِى رَبِّى لَأَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
en: (77) And when he saw the moon rising, he said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "Unless my Lord guides me, I will surely be among the people gone astray."
tr: Falammā raʾal-qamara bāzighan qāla hādhā rabbī, falammā afala qāla laʾil lam yahdinī rabbī laʾakūnanna minal-qawmiḍ-ḍāllīn

ar: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلشَّمْسَ بَازِغَةً قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّى هَٰذَآ أَكْبَرُ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَتْ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
en: (78) And when he saw the sun rising, he said, "This is my lord; this is greater." But when it set, he said, "O my people, indeed I am free from what you associate with Allāh.
tr: Falammā raʾash-shamsa bāzighatan qāla hādhā rabbī hādhā akbar, falammā afalat qāla yāqawmi innī barīʾum mimmā tushrikūn

ar: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
en: (79) Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh."
tr: Innī wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhī faṭaras-samāwāti wal-arḍa ḥanīfaw wamā ana minal-mushrikīn

ar: وَحَآجَّهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ قَالَ أَتُحَٰٓجُّوٓنِّى فِى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَىٰنِ وَلَآ أَخَافُ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ رَبِّى شَيْـًٔا وَسِعَ رَبِّى كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
en: (80) And his people argued with him. He said, "Do you argue with me concerning Allāh while He has guided me? And I fear not what you associate with Him [and will not be harmed] unless my Lord should will something. My Lord encompasses all things in knowledge; then will you not remember?
tr: Waḥājjahū qawmuh, qāla atuḥājjūnnī fillāhi waqad hadān, walā akhāfu mā tushrikūna bihī illā ay yashāʾa rabbī shayʾā, wasiʿa rabbī kulla shayʾin ʿilmā, afalā tatadhakkarūn

ar: وَكَيْفَ أَخَافُ مَآ أَشْرَكْتُمْ وَلَا تَخَافُونَ أَنَّكُمْ أَشْرَكْتُم بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطَٰنًا فَأَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِٱلْأَمْنِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (81) And how should I fear what you associate while you do not fear that you have associated with Allāh that for which He has not sent down to you any authority? So which of the two parties has more right to security, if you should know?"
tr: Wakayfa akhāfu mā ashraktum walā takhāfūna annakum ashraktum billāhi mā lam yunazzil bihī ʿalaykum sulṭānā, faʾayyul-farīqayni aḥaqqu bil-amn, in kuntum taʿlamūn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنَهُم بِظُلْمٍ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلْأَمْنُ وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
en: (82) They who believe and do not mix their belief with injustice[323] - those will have security, and they are [rightly] guided.
enNotes: [323]- Specifically, the association of others in divinity with Allāh.
tr: Alladhīna āmanū walam yalbisū īmānahum biẓulmin ulāʾika lahumul-amnu wahum muhtadūn

ar: وَتِلْكَ حُجَّتُنَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَٰتٍ مَّن نَّشَآءُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
en: (83) And that was Our [conclusive] argument which We gave Abraham against his people. We raise by degrees whom We will. Indeed, your Lord is Wise and Knowing.
tr: Watilka ḥujjatunā ātaynāhā ibrāhīma ʿalā qawmih, narfaʿu darajātim man nashāʾ, inna rabbaka ḥakīmun ʿalīm

ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ كُلًّا هَدَيْنَا وَنُوحًا هَدَيْنَا مِن قَبْلُ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِۦ دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُوسُفَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
en: (84) And We gave to him [i.e., Abraham] Isaac and Jacob - all [of them] We guided. And Noah, We guided before; and among his descendants, David and Solomon and Job and Joseph and Moses and Aaron. Thus do We reward the doers of good.
tr: Wawahabnā lahū isḥāqa wayaʿqūb, kullan hadaynā wanūḥan hadaynā min qablu wamin dhurriyyatihī dāwūda wasulaymāna waʾayyūba wayūsufa wamūsā wahārūn, wakadhālika najzil-muḥsinīn

ar: وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَإِلْيَاسَ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
en: (85) And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous.
tr: Wazakariyyā wayaḥyā waʿīsā waʾilyās, kullum minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn

ar: وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطًا وَكُلًّا فَضَّلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (86) And Ishmael and Elisha and Jonah and Lot - and all [of them] We preferred over the worlds.
tr: Waʾismāʿīla wal-yasaʿa wayūnusa walūṭā, wakullan faḍḍalnā ʿalal-ʿālamīn

ar: وَمِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ وَإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ وَٱجْتَبَيْنَٰهُمْ وَهَدَيْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
en: (87) And [some] among their fathers and their descendants and their brothers - and We chose them and We guided them to a straight path.
tr: Wamin ābāʾihim wadhurriyyātihim waʾikhwānihim, wajtabaynāhum wahadaynāhum ilā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm

ar: ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَلَوْ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَحَبِطَ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (88) That is the guidance of Allāh by which He guides whomever He wills of His servants. But if they had associated others with Allāh, then worthless for them would be whatever they were doing.
tr: Dhālika hudallāhi yahdī bihī may yashāʾu min ʿibādih, walaw ashrakū laḥabiṭa ʿanhum mā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ فَإِن يَكْفُرْ بِهَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ فَقَدْ وَكَّلْنَا بِهَا قَوْمًا لَّيْسُوا۟ بِهَا بِكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (89) Those are the ones to whom We gave the Scripture and authority and prophethood. But if they [i.e., the disbelievers] deny it, then We have entrusted it to a people who are not therein disbelievers.
tr: Ulāʾikal-ladhīna ātaynāhumul-kitāba wal-ḥukma wan-nubuwwah, faʾiy yakfur bihā hāʾulāʾi faqad wakkalnā bihā qawmal laysū bihā bikāfirīn

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ فَبِهُدَىٰهُمُ ٱقْتَدِهْ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (90) Those are the ones whom Allāh has guided, so from their guidance take an example. Say, "I ask of you for it [i.e., this message] no payment. It is not but a reminder for the worlds."
tr: Ulāʾikal-ladhīna hadallāhu fabihudāhumuqtadih, qul lā asʾalukum ʿalayhi ajrā, in huwa illā dhikrā lil-ʿālamīn

ar: وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ بَشَرٍ مِّن شَىْءٍ قُلْ مَنْ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِهِۦ مُوسَىٰ نُورًا وَهُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ تَجْعَلُونَهُۥ قَرَاطِيسَ تُبْدُونَهَا وَتُخْفُونَ كَثِيرًا وَعُلِّمْتُم مَّا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنتُمْ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ذَرْهُمْ فِى خَوْضِهِمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
en: (91) And they did not appraise Allāh with true appraisal[324] when they said, "Allāh did not reveal to a human being anything." Say, "Who revealed the Scripture that Moses brought as light and guidance to the people? You [Jews] make it into pages, disclosing [some of] it and concealing much. And you[325] were taught that which you knew not - neither you nor your fathers." Say, "Allāh [revealed it]." Then leave them in their [empty] discourse, amusing themselves.
enNotes:
[324]- i.e., they did not appreciate the extent of His ability and wisdom.
[325]- The Jews, or it may refer to the believers, who are taught by the Qur’ān.
tr: Wamā qadarullāha ḥaqqa qadrihī idh qālū mā anzalallāhu ʿalā basharim min shayʾ, qul man anzalal-kitābal-ladhī jāʾa bihī mūsā nūraw wahudal lin-nāsi tajʿalūnahū qarāṭīsa tubdūnahā watukhfūna kathīrā, waʿullimtum mā lam taʿlamū antum walā ābāʾukum, qulillāhu thumma dharhum fī khawḍihim yalʿabūn

ar: وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مُبَارَكٌ مُّصَدِّقُ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَلِتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
en: (92) And this is a Book which We have sent down, blessed and confirming what was before it, that you may warn the Mother of Cities [i.e., Makkah] and those around it.[326] Those who believe in the Hereafter believe in it, and they are maintaining their prayers.
enNotes: [326]- i.e., all other peoples.
tr: Wahādhā kitābun anzalnāhu mubārakum muṣaddiqul-ladhī bayna yadayhi walitundhira ummal-qurā waman ḥawlahā, wal-ladhīna yuʾminūna bil-ākhirati yuʾminūna bihī wahum ʿalā ṣalātihim yuḥāfiẓūn

ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ قَالَ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ وَلَمْ يُوحَ إِلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ وَمَن قَالَ سَأُنزِلُ مِثْلَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ فِى غَمَرَٰتِ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَاسِطُوٓا۟ أَيْدِيهِمْ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ ٱلْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَكُنتُمْ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
en: (93) And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allāh or says, "It has been inspired to me," while nothing has been inspired to him, and one who says, "I will reveal [something] like what Allāh revealed." And if you could but see when the wrongdoers are in the overwhelming pangs of death while the angels extend their hands,[327] [saying], "Discharge your souls! Today you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation for what you used to say against Allāh other than the truth and [that] you were, toward His verses, being arrogant."
enNotes: [327]- Striking them, as they are unwilling to give up their souls for judgement.
tr: Waman aẓlamu mimmaniftarā ʿalallāhi kadhiban aw qāla ūḥiya ilayya walam yūḥa ilayhi shayʾuw waman qāla saʾunzilu mithla mā anzalallāh, walaw tarā idhiẓ-ẓālimūna fī ghamarātil-mawti wal-malāʾikatu bāsiṭū aydīhim, akhrijū anfusakum, al-yawma tujzawna ʿadhābal-hūni bimā kuntum taqūlūna ʿalallāhi ghayral-ḥaqqi wakuntum ʿan āyātihī tastakbirūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا فُرَٰدَىٰ كَمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَتَرَكْتُم مَّا خَوَّلْنَٰكُمْ وَرَآءَ ظُهُورِكُمْ وَمَا نَرَىٰ مَعَكُمْ شُفَعَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّهُمْ فِيكُمْ شُرَكَٰٓؤُا۟ لَقَد تَّقَطَّعَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَضَلَّ عَنكُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ
en: (94) [It will be said to them], "And you have certainly come to Us alone [i.e., individually] as We created you the first time, and you have left whatever We bestowed upon you behind you. And We do not see with you your 'intercessors' which you claimed that they were among you associates [of Allāh]. It has [all] been severed between you,[328] and lost from you is what you used to claim."
enNotes: [328]- Between yourselves and the claimed associates and intercessors.
tr: Walaqad jiʾtumūnā furādā kamā khalaqnākum awwala marratiw wataraktum mā khawwalnākum warāʾa ẓuhūrikum, wamā narā maʿakum shufaʿāʾakumul-ladhīna zaʿamtum annahum fīkum shurakāʾ, laqat taqaṭṭaʿa baynakum waḍalla ʿankum mā kuntum tazʿumūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ فَالِقُ ٱلْحَبِّ وَٱلنَّوَىٰ يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَمُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتِ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
en: (95) Indeed, Allāh is the cleaver of grain and date seeds.[329] He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living. That is Allāh; so how are you deluded?
enNotes: [329]- He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) causes them to split and sprout.
tr: Innallāha fāliqul-ḥabbi wan-nawā, yukhrijul-ḥayya minal-mayyiti wamukhrijul-mayyiti minal-ḥayy, dhālikumullāhu faʾannā tuʾfakūn

ar: فَالِقُ ٱلْإِصْبَاحِ وَجَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ سَكَنًا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ حُسْبَانًا ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
en: (96) [He is] the cleaver of daybreak and has made the night for rest and the sun and moon for calculation.[330] That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
enNotes: [330]- Or "according to calculation," referring to their precise movement.
tr: Fāliqul-iṣbāḥ, wajaʿalal-layla sakanaw wash-shamsa wal-qamara ḥusbānā, dhālika taqdīrul-ʿazīzil-ʿalīm

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلنُّجُومَ لِتَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهَا فِى ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (97) And it is He who placed for you the stars that you may be guided by them through the darknesses of the land and sea. We have detailed the signs for a people who know.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī jaʿala lakumun-nujūma litahtadū bihā fī ẓulumātil-barri wal-baḥr, qad faṣṣalnal-āyāti liqawmiy yaʿlamūn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ فَمُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمُسْتَوْدَعٌ قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَفْقَهُونَ
en: (98) And it is He who produced you from one soul and [gave you] a place of dwelling and of storage.[331] We have detailed the signs for a people who understand.
enNotes: [331]- In the earth. See 77:25-26.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī anshaʾakum min nafsiw wāḥidatin famustaqarruw wamustawdaʿ, qad faṣṣalnal-āyāti liqawmiy yafqahūn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ نَبَاتَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهُ خَضِرًا نُّخْرِجُ مِنْهُ حَبًّا مُّتَرَاكِبًا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّخْلِ مِن طَلْعِهَا قِنْوَانٌ دَانِيَةٌ وَجَنَّٰتٍ مِّنْ أَعْنَابٍ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُشْتَبِهًا وَغَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ ٱنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثْمَرَ وَيَنْعِهِۦٓ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكُمْ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (99) And it is He who sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby the growth of all things. We produce from it greenery from which We produce grains arranged in layers. And from the palm trees - of its emerging fruit are clusters hanging low. And [We produce] gardens of grapevines and olives and pomegranates, similar yet varied. Look at [each of] its fruit when it yields and [at] its ripening. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī anzala minas-samāʾi māʾā, faʾakhrajnā bihī nabāta kulli shayʾin faʾakhrajnā minhu khaḍiran nukhriju minhu ḥabbam mutarākibā, waminan-nakhli min ṭalʿihā qinwānun dāniyatuw wajannātim min aʿnābiw waz-zaytūna war-rummāna mushtabihaw waghayra mutashābih, unẓurū ilā thamarihī idhā athmara wayanʿih, inna fī dhālikum laʾāyātil liqawmiy yuʾminūn

ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ ٱلْجِنَّ وَخَلَقَهُمْ وَخَرَقُوا۟ لَهُۥ بَنِينَ وَبَنَٰتٍۭ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
en: (100) But they have attributed to Allāh partners - the jinn, while He has created them - and have fabricated for Him sons and daughters without knowledge. Exalted is He and high above what they describe.
tr: Wajaʿalū lillāhi shurakāʾal-jinna wakhalaqahum wakharaqū lahū banīna wabanātim bighayri ʿilm, subḥānahū wataʿālā ʿammā yaṣifūn

ar: بَدِيعُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُۥ وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُۥ صَٰحِبَةٌ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
en: (101) [He is] Originator of the heavens and the earth. How could He have a son when He does not have a companion [i.e., wife] and He created all things? And He is, of all things, Knowing.
tr: Badīʿus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, annā yakūnu lahū waladuw walam takul lahū ṣāḥibah, wakhalaqa kulla shayʾ, wahuwa bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm

ar: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
en: (102) That is Allāh, your Lord; there is no deity except Him, the Creator of all things, so worship Him. And He is Disposer of all things.
tr: Dhālikumullāhu rabbukum, lā ilāha illā huw, khāliqu kulli shayʾin faʿbudūh, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾiw wakīl

ar: لَّا تُدْرِكُهُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
en: (103) Vision perceives Him not,[332] but He perceives [all] vision; and He is the Subtle,[333] the Aware.[334]
enNotes:
[332]- In the life of this world. The people of Paradise will be able to see Allāh in the Hereafter. See 75:22-23.
[333]- Perceptive of the most precise and unapparent matters and the intricacies of all affairs. Also, He who benefits His servants in indiscernible ways.
[334]- See footnote in 6:18.
tr: Lā tudrikuhul-abṣāru wahuwa yudrikul-abṣār, wahuwal-laṭīful-khabīr

ar: قَدْ جَآءَكُم بَصَآئِرُ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَمَنْ أَبْصَرَ فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ وَمَنْ عَمِىَ فَعَلَيْهَا وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِحَفِيظٍ
en: (104) There has come to you enlightenment from your Lord. So whoever will see does so for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever is blind [does harm] against it. And [say], "I am not a guardian over you."[335]
enNotes: [335]- The Prophet (ﷺ) is directed to disassociate himself from all erroneous belief and practice.
tr: Qad jāʾakum baṣāʾiru mir rabbikum, faman abṣara falinafsih, waman ʿamiya faʿalayhā, wamā ana ʿalaykum biḥafīẓ

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ وَلِيَقُولُوا۟ دَرَسْتَ وَلِنُبَيِّنَهُۥ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (105) And thus do We diversify the verses so they [i.e., the disbelievers] will say, "You have studied,"[336] and so We may make it [i.e., the Qur’ān] clear for a people who know.
enNotes: [336]- Accusing the Prophet (ﷺ) of having learned from the Jews and Christians.
tr: Wakadhālika nuṣarriful-āyāti waliyaqūlū darasta walinubayyinahū liqawmiy yaʿlamūn

ar: ٱتَّبِعْ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
en: (106) Follow, [O Muḥammad], what has been revealed to you from your Lord - there is no deity except Him - and turn away from those who associate others with Allāh.
tr: Ittabiʿ mā ūḥiya ilayka mir rabbik, lā ilāha illā huw, waʾaʿriḍ ʿanil-mushrikīn

ar: وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَآ أَشْرَكُوا۟ وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
en: (107) But if Allāh had willed, they would not have associated. And We have not appointed you over them as a guardian, nor are you a manager over them.[337]
enNotes: [337]- The Prophet's duty did not go beyond delivery of the message.
tr: Walaw shāʾallāhu mā ashrakū, wamā jaʿalnāka ʿalayhim ḥafīẓā, wamā anta ʿalayhim biwakīl

ar: وَلَا تَسُبُّوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَسُبُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَدْوًۢا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ كَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَّا لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ عَمَلَهُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِم مَّرْجِعُهُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (108) And do not insult those they invoke other than Allāh, lest they insult Allāh in enmity without knowledge. Thus We have made pleasing to every community their deeds. Then to their Lord is their return, and He will inform them about what they used to do.
tr: Walā tasubbul-ladhīna yadʿūna min dūnillāhi fayasubbullāha ʿadwam bighayri ʿilm, kadhālika zayyannā likulli ummatin ʿamalahum, thumma ilā rabbihim marjiʿuhum fayunabbiʾuhum bimā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَةٌ لَّيُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهَا قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْـَٔايَٰتُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا يُشْعِرُكُمْ أَنَّهَآ إِذَا جَآءَتْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (109) And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths that if a sign came to them, they would surely believe in it. Say, "The signs are only with [i.e., from] Allāh." And what will make you perceive that even if it [i.e., a sign] came, they would not believe.
tr: Waʾaqsamū billāhi jahda aymānihim laʾin jāʾathum āyatul layuʾminunna bihā, qul innamal-āyātu ʿindallāhi wamā yushʿirukum annahā idhā jāʾat lā yuʾminūn

ar: وَنُقَلِّبُ أَفْـِٔدَتَهُمْ وَأَبْصَٰرَهُمْ كَمَا لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَنَذَرُهُمْ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
en: (110) And We will turn away their hearts and their eyes just as they refused to believe in it [i.e., the revelation] the first time. And We will leave them in their transgression, wandering blindly.
tr: Wanuqallibu afʾidatahum waʾabṣārahum kamā lam yuʾminū bihī awwala marratiw wanadharuhum fī ṭughyānihim yaʿmahūn

ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّنَا نَزَّلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ وَكَلَّمَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَحَشَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ قُبُلًا مَّا كَانُوا۟ لِيُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَجْهَلُونَ
en: (111) And even if We had sent down to them the angels [with the message] and the dead spoke to them [of it] and We gathered together every [created] thing in front of them, they would not believe unless Allāh should will. But most of them, [of that], are ignorant.
tr: Walaw annanā nazzalnā ilayhimul-malāʾikata wakallamahumul-mawtā waḥasharnā ʿalayhim kulla shayʾin qubulam mā kānū liyuʾminū illā ay yashāʾallāhu walākinna aktharahum yajhalūn

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا شَيَٰطِينَ ٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلْجِنِّ يُوحِى بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ زُخْرُفَ ٱلْقَوْلِ غُرُورًا وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ مَا فَعَلُوهُ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ
en: (112) And thus We have made for every prophet an enemy - devils from mankind and jinn, inspiring to one another decorative speech in delusion. But if your Lord had willed, they would not have done it, so leave them and that which they invent.
tr: Wakadhālika jaʿalnā likulli nabiyyin ʿaduwwan shayāṭīnal-insi wal-jinni yūḥī baʿḍuhum ilā baʿḍin zukhrufal-qawli ghurūrā, walaw shāʾa rabbuka mā faʿalūhu fadharhum wamā yaftarūn

ar: وَلِتَصْغَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ أَفْـِٔدَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَلِيَرْضَوْهُ وَلِيَقْتَرِفُوا۟ مَا هُم مُّقْتَرِفُونَ
en: (113) And [it is] so the hearts of those who disbelieve in the Hereafter will incline toward it [i.e., deceptive speech] and that they will be satisfied with it and that they will commit that which they are committing.
tr: Walitaṣghā ilayhi afʾidatul-ladhīna lā yuʾminūna bil-ākhirati waliyarḍawhu waliyaqtarifū mā hum muqtarifūn

ar: أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ أَبْتَغِى حَكَمًا وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مُفَصَّلًا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُۥ مُنَزَّلٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
en: (114) [Say], "Then is it other than Allāh I should seek as judge while it is He who has revealed to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] explained in detail?" And those to whom We [previously] gave the Scripture know that it is sent down from your Lord in truth, so never be among the doubters.
tr: Afaghayrallāhi abtaghī ḥakamaw wahuwal-ladhī anzala ilaykumul-kitāba mufaṣṣalā, wal-ladhīna ātaynāhumul-kitāba yaʿlamūna annahū munazzalum mir rabbika bil-ḥaqqi falā takūnanna minal-mumtarīn

ar: وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدْقًا وَعَدْلًا لَّا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (115) And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice. None can alter His words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr: Watammat kalimatu rabbika ṣidqaw waʿadlā, lā mubaddila likalimātih, wahuwas-samīʿul-ʿalīm

ar: وَإِن تُطِعْ أَكْثَرَ مَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يُضِلُّوكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
en: (116) And if you obey most of those upon the earth, they will mislead you from the way of Allāh. They follow not except assumption, and they are not but misjudging.[338]
enNotes: [338]- Out of ignorance and blind imitation.
tr: Waʾin tuṭiʿ akthara man fil-arḍi yuḍillūka ʿan sabīlillāh, iy yattabiʿūna illaẓ-ẓanna waʾin hum illā yakhruṣūn

ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ مَن يَضِلُّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
en: (117) Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
tr: Inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu may yaḍillu ʿan sabīlih, wahuwa aʿlamu bil-muhtadīn

ar: فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا ذُكِرَ ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُم بِـَٔايَٰتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (118) So eat of that [meat] upon which the name of Allāh has been mentioned,[339] if you are believers in His verses [i.e., revealed law].
enNotes: [339]- At the time of slaughter.
tr: Fakulū mimmā dhukirasmullāhi ʿalayhi in kuntum biʾāyātihī muʾminīn

ar: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا ذُكِرَ ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَقَدْ فَصَّلَ لَكُم مَّا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِلَّا مَا ٱضْطُرِرْتُمْ إِلَيْهِ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا لَّيُضِلُّونَ بِأَهْوَآئِهِم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
en: (119) And why should you not eat of that upon which the name of Allāh has been mentioned while He has explained in detail to you what He has forbidden you, excepting that to which you are compelled.[340] And indeed do many lead [others] astray through their [own] inclinations without knowledge. Indeed, your Lord - He is most knowing of the transgressors.
enNotes: [340]- In cases of dire necessity, what is normally prohibited becomes permissible, but only to the extent of the need.
tr: Wamā lakum allā taʾkulū mimmā dhukirasmullāhi ʿalayhi waqad faṣṣala lakum mā ḥarrama ʿalaykum illā maḍṭurirtum ilayh, waʾinna kathīral layuḍillūna biʾahwāʾihim bighayri ʿilm, inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu bil-muʿtadīn

ar: وَذَرُوا۟ ظَٰهِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَبَاطِنَهُۥٓ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْسِبُونَ ٱلْإِثْمَ سَيُجْزَوْنَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَقْتَرِفُونَ
en: (120) And leave [i.e., desist from] what is apparent of sin and what is concealed thereof. Indeed, those who earn [blame for] sin will be recompensed for that which they used to commit.
tr: Wadharū ẓāhiral-ithmi wabāṭinah, innal-ladhīna yaksibūnal-ithma sayujzawna bimā kānū yaqtarifūn

ar: وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا لَمْ يُذْكَرِ ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِسْقٌ وَإِنَّ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ لَيُوحُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآئِهِمْ لِيُجَٰدِلُوكُمْ وَإِنْ أَطَعْتُمُوهُمْ إِنَّكُمْ لَمُشْرِكُونَ
en: (121) And do not eat of that upon which the name of Allāh has not been mentioned, for indeed, it is grave disobedience. And indeed do the devils inspire their allies [among men] to dispute with you. And if you were to obey them, indeed, you would be associators [of others with Him].[341]
enNotes: [341]- i.e., by your obedience to them - obedience being the basis of worship.
tr: Walā taʾkulū mimmā lam yudhkarismullāhi ʿalayhi waʾinnahū lafisq, waʾinnash-shayāṭīna layūḥūna ilā awliyāʾihim liyujādilūkum, waʾin aṭaʿtumūhum innakum lamushrikūn

ar: أَوَمَن كَانَ مَيْتًا فَأَحْيَيْنَٰهُ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُۥ نُورًا يَمْشِى بِهِۦ فِى ٱلنَّاسِ كَمَن مَّثَلُهُۥ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ لَيْسَ بِخَارِجٍ مِّنْهَا كَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (122) And is one who was dead and We gave him life and made for him light by which to walk among the people like one who is in darkness, never to emerge therefrom? Thus it has been made pleasing to the disbelievers that which they were doing.
tr: Awaman kāna maytan faʾaḥyaynāhu wajaʿalnā lahū nūray yamshī bihī fin-nāsi kamam mathaluhū fiẓ-ẓulumāti laysa bikhārijim minhā, kadhālika zuyyina lil-kāfirīna mā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ أَكَٰبِرَ مُجْرِمِيهَا لِيَمْكُرُوا۟ فِيهَا وَمَا يَمْكُرُونَ إِلَّا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
en: (123) And thus We have placed within every city the greatest of its criminals to conspire therein. But they conspire not except against themselves, and they perceive [it] not.
tr: Wakadhālika jaʿalnā fī kulli qaryatin akābira mujrimīhā liyamkurū fīhā, wamā yamkurūna illā biʾanfusihim wamā yashʿurūn

ar: وَإِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَةٌ قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ حَتَّىٰ نُؤْتَىٰ مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ رُسُلُ ٱللَّهِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ حَيْثُ يَجْعَلُ رِسَالَتَهُۥ سَيُصِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ صَغَارٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَمْكُرُونَ
en: (124) And when a sign comes to them, they say, "Never will we believe until we are given like that which was given to the messengers of Allāh." Allāh is most knowing of where [i.e., with whom] He places His message. There will afflict those who committed crimes debasement before Allāh and severe punishment for what they used to conspire.
tr: Waʾidhā jāʾathum āyatun qālū lan nuʾmina ḥattā nuʾtā mithla mā ūtiya rusulullāh, allāhu aʿlamu ḥaythu yajʿalu risālatah, sayuṣībul-ladhīna ajramū ṣaghārun ʿindallāhi waʿadhābun shadīdum bimā kānū yamkurūn

ar: فَمَن يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَهْدِيَهُۥ يَشْرَحْ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَٰمِ وَمَن يُرِدْ أَن يُضِلَّهُۥ يَجْعَلْ صَدْرَهُۥ ضَيِّقًا حَرَجًا كَأَنَّمَا يَصَّعَّدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّجْسَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (125) So whoever Allāh wants to guide - He expands his breast to [contain] Islām; and whoever He wants to send astray[342] - He makes his breast tight and constricted as though he were climbing into the sky. Thus does Allāh place defilement upon those who do not believe.
enNotes: [342]- As a result of the person's arrogance and persistence in sin.
tr: Famay yuridillāhu ay yahdiyahū yashraḥ ṣadrahū lil-islām, wamay yurid ay yuḍillahū yajʿal ṣadrahū ḍayyiqan ḥarajan kaʾannamā yaṣṣaʿʿadu fis-samāʾ, kadhālika yajʿalullāhur-rijsa ʿalal-ladhīna lā yuʾminūn

ar: وَهَٰذَا صِرَٰطُ رَبِّكَ مُسْتَقِيمًا قَدْ فَصَّلْنَا ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
en: (126) And this is the path of your Lord, [leading] straight. We have detailed the verses for a people who remember.
tr: Wahādhā ṣirāṭu rabbika mustaqīmā, qad faṣṣalnal-āyāti liqawmiy yadhdhakkarūn

ar: لَهُمْ دَارُ ٱلسَّلَٰمِ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (127) For them will be the Home of Peace [i.e., Paradise] with their Lord. And He will be their protecting friend because of what they used to do.
tr: Lahum dārus-salāmi ʿinda rabbihim wahuwa waliyyuhum bimā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ قَدِ ٱسْتَكْثَرْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ وَقَالَ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ رَبَّنَا ٱسْتَمْتَعَ بَعْضُنَا بِبَعْضٍ وَبَلَغْنَآ أَجَلَنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَجَّلْتَ لَنَا قَالَ ٱلنَّارُ مَثْوَىٰكُمْ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
en: (128) And [mention, O Muḥammad], the Day when He will gather them together [and say], "O company of jinn, you have [misled] many of mankind." And their allies among mankind will say, "Our Lord, some of us made use of others, and we have [now] reached our term which You appointed for us." He will say, "The Fire is your residence, wherein you will abide eternally, except for what Allāh wills. Indeed, your Lord is Wise and Knowing."
tr: Wayawma yaḥshuruhum jamīʿā, yāmaʿsharal-jinni qadistakthartum minal-ins, waqāla awliyāʾuhum minal-insi rabbanastamtaʿa baʿḍunā bibaʿḍiw wabalaghnā ajalanal-ladhī ajjalta lanā, qālan-nāru mathwākum khālidīna fīhā illā mā shāʾallāh, inna rabbaka ḥakīmun ʿalīm

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُوَلِّى بَعْضَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعْضًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
en: (129) And thus will We make some of the wrongdoers allies of others for what they used to earn.[343]
enNotes: [343]- Another interpretation pertaining to this world is "And thus do We make some of the wrongdoers allies of others for what they have been earning."
tr: Wakadhālika nuwallī baʿḍaẓ-ẓālimīna baʿḍam bimā kānū yaksibūn

ar: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِى وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا قَالُوا۟ شَهِدْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِنَا وَغَرَّتْهُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَشَهِدُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَٰفِرِينَ
en: (130) "O company of jinn and mankind,[344] did there not come to you messengers from among you, relating to you My verses and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "We bear witness against ourselves"; and the worldly life had deluded them, and they will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.
enNotes: [344]- They will be reproached thus at the Judgement.
tr: Yāmaʿsharal-jinni wal-insi alam yaʾtikum rusulum minkum yaquṣṣūna ʿalaykum āyātī wayundhirūnakum liqāʾa yawmikum hādhā, qālū shahidnā ʿalā anfusinā wagharrathumul-ḥayātud-dunyā washahidū ʿalā anfusihim annahum kānū kāfirīn

ar: ذَٰلِكَ أَن لَّمْ يَكُن رَّبُّكَ مُهْلِكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا غَٰفِلُونَ
en: (131) That is because your Lord would not destroy the cities for wrongdoing[345] while their people were unaware.
enNotes: [345]- Or "unjustly."
tr: Dhālika al lam yakur rabbuka muhlikal-qurā biẓulmiw waʾahluhā ghāfilūn

ar: وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَٰتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا۟ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (132) And for all are degrees [i.e., positions resulting] from what they have done. And your Lord is not unaware of what they do.
tr: Walikullin darajātum mimmā ʿamilū, wamā rabbuka bighāfilin ʿammā yaʿmalūn

ar: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفْ مِنۢ بَعْدِكُم مَّا يَشَآءُ كَمَآ أَنشَأَكُم مِّن ذُرِّيَّةِ قَوْمٍ ءَاخَرِينَ
en: (133) And your Lord is the Free of need, the possessor of mercy. If He wills, He can do away with you and give succession after you to whomever He wills, just as He produced you from the descendants of another people.
tr: Warabbukal-ghaniyyu dhur-raḥmah, iy yashaʾ yudhhibkum wayastakhlif mim baʿdikum mā yashāʾu kamā anshaʾakum min dhurriyyati qawmin ākharīn

ar: إِنَّ مَا تُوعَدُونَ لَـَٔاتٍ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
en: (134) Indeed, what you are promised is coming, and you will not cause failure [to Allāh].[346]
enNotes: [346]- i.e., You will neither escape nor prevent its occurrence.
tr: Inna mā tūʿadūna laʾātiw wamā antum bimuʿjizīn

ar: قُلْ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَامِلٌ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن تَكُونُ لَهُۥ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلدَّارِ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
en: (135) Say, "O my people, work according to your position; [for] indeed, I am working. And you are going to know who will have succession in the home.[347] Indeed, the wrongdoers will not succeed."
enNotes: [347]- i.e., in the land or in the Hereafter.
tr: Qul yāqawmiʿmalū ʿalā makānatikum innī ʿāmil, fasawfa taʿlamūna man takūnu lahū ʿāqibatud-dār, innahū lā yufliḥuẓ-ẓālimūn

ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مِمَّا ذَرَأَ مِنَ ٱلْحَرْثِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ نَصِيبًا فَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا لِلَّهِ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَهَٰذَا لِشُرَكَآئِنَا فَمَا كَانَ لِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ فَلَا يَصِلُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ فَهُوَ يَصِلُ إِلَىٰ شُرَكَآئِهِمْ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
en: (136) And they [i.e., the polytheists] assign to Allāh from that which He created of crops and livestock a share and say, "This is for Allāh," by their claim, "and this is for our 'partners' [associated with Him]." But what is for their "partners" does not reach Allāh, while what is for Allāh - this reaches their "partners." Evil is that which they rule.
tr: Wajaʿalū lillāhi mimmā dharaʾa minal-ḥarthi wal-anʿāmi naṣīban faqālū hādhā lillāhi bizaʿmihim wahādhā lishurakāʾinā, famā kāna lishurakāʾihim falā yaṣilu ilallāh, wamā kāna lillāhi fahuwa yaṣilu ilā shurakāʾihim, sāʾa mā yaḥkumūn

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ زَيَّنَ لِكَثِيرٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ قَتْلَ أَوْلَٰدِهِمْ شُرَكَآؤُهُمْ لِيُرْدُوهُمْ وَلِيَلْبِسُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ دِينَهُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فَعَلُوهُ فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ
en: (137) And likewise, to many of the polytheists their partners[348] have made [to seem] pleasing the killing of their children in order to bring about their destruction and to cover them with confusion in their religion. And if Allāh had willed, they would not have done so. So leave them and that which they invent.
enNotes: [348]- Their evil associates.
tr: Wakadhālika zayyana likathīrim minal-mushrikīna qatla awlādihim shurakāʾuhum liyurdūhum waliyalbisū ʿalayhim dīnahum, walaw shāʾallāhu mā faʿalūhu fadharhum wamā yaftarūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَنْعَٰمٌ وَحَرْثٌ حِجْرٌ لَّا يَطْعَمُهَآ إِلَّا مَن نَّشَآءُ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَأَنْعَٰمٌ حُرِّمَتْ ظُهُورُهَا وَأَنْعَٰمٌ لَّا يَذْكُرُونَ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا ٱفْتِرَآءً عَلَيْهِ سَيَجْزِيهِم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
en: (138) And they say, "These animals[349] and crops are forbidden; no one may eat from them except whom we will," by their claim. And there are those [camels] whose backs are forbidden [by them][350] and those upon which the name of Allāh is not mentioned[351] - [all of this] an invention of untruth about Him.[352] He will punish them for what they were inventing.
enNotes:
[349]- The four categories of grazing livestock called "anʿām" collectively.
[350]- See 5:103.
[351]- At the time of slaughter. Rather, they are dedicated to others among their "deities."
[352]- i.e., false assertions that such practices are part of Allāh's religion.
tr: Waqālū hādhihī anʿāmuw waḥarthun ḥijrul lā yaṭʿamuhā illā man nashāʾu bizaʿmihim waʾanʿāmun ḥurrimat ẓuhūruhā waʾanʿāmul lā yadhkurūnasmallāhi ʿalayhaftirāʾan ʿalayh, sayajzīhim bimā kānū yaftarūn

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا فِى بُطُونِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ خَالِصَةٌ لِّذُكُورِنَا وَمُحَرَّمٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَإِن يَكُن مَّيْتَةً فَهُمْ فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ سَيَجْزِيهِمْ وَصْفَهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
en: (139) And they say, "What is in the bellies of these animals[353] is exclusively for our males and forbidden to our females. But if it is [born] dead, then all of them have shares therein." He will punish them for their description.[354] Indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
enNotes:
[353]- i.e., their milk and offspring.
[354]- Of what is lawful and unlawful according to their whims.
tr: Waqālū mā fī buṭūni hādhihil-anʿāmi khāliṣatul lidhukūrinā wamuḥarramun ʿalā azwājinā, waʾiy yakum maytatan fahum fīhi shurakāʾ, sayajzīhim waṣfahum, innahū ḥakīmun ʿalīm

ar: قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَتَلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَهُمْ سَفَهًۢا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَحَرَّمُوا۟ مَا رَزَقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱفْتِرَآءً عَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
en: (140) They will have lost who killed their children in foolishness without knowledge and prohibited what Allāh had provided for them, inventing untruth about Allāh. They have gone astray and were not [rightly] guided.
tr: Qad khasiral-ladhīna qatalū awlādahum safaham bighayri ʿilmiw waḥarramū mā razaqahumullāhuftirāʾan ʿalallāh, qad ḍallū wamā kānū muhtadīn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ جَنَّٰتٍ مَّعْرُوشَٰتٍ وَغَيْرَ مَعْرُوشَٰتٍ وَٱلنَّخْلَ وَٱلزَّرْعَ مُخْتَلِفًا أُكُلُهُۥ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلرُّمَّانَ مُتَشَٰبِهًا وَغَيْرَ مُتَشَٰبِهٍ كُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦٓ إِذَآ أَثْمَرَ وَءَاتُوا۟ حَقَّهُۥ يَوْمَ حَصَادِهِۦ وَلَا تُسْرِفُوٓا۟ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
en: (141) And He it is who causes gardens to grow, [both] trellised and untrellised, and palm trees and crops of different [kinds of] food and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of [each of] its fruit when it yields and give its due [zakāh] on the day of its harvest. And be not excessive.[355] Indeed, He does not like those who commit excess.
enNotes: [355]- In eating, as well as in all things generally.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī anshaʾa jannātim maʿrūshātiw waghayra maʿrūshātiw wan-nakhla waz-zarʿa mukhtalifan ukuluhū waz-zaytūna war-rummāna mutashābihaw waghayra mutashābih, kulū min thamarihī idhā athmara waʾātū ḥaqqahū yawma ḥaṣādih, walā tusrifū, innahū lā yuḥibbul-musrifīn

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ حَمُولَةً وَفَرْشًا كُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
en: (142) And of the grazing livestock are carriers [of burdens] and those [too] small. Eat of what Allāh has provided for you and do not follow the footsteps of Satan.[356] Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
enNotes: [356]- As the disbelievers have done in making their own rulings about what is permissible and what is prohibited.
tr: Waminal-anʿāmi ḥamūlataw wafarshā, kulū mimmā razaqakumullāhu walā tattabiʿū khuṭuwātish-shayṭān, innahū lakum ʿaduwwum mubīn

ar: ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍ مِّنَ ٱلضَّأْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمَعْزِ ٱثْنَيْنِ قُلْ ءَآلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمَّا ٱشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ نَبِّـُٔونِى بِعِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (143) [They are] eight mates - of the sheep, two and of the goats, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Inform me with knowledge, if you should be truthful."
tr: Thamāniyata azwāj, minaḍ-ḍaʾnithnayni waminal-maʿzithnayn, qul ādh-dhakarayni ḥarrama amil-unthayayni ammashtamalat ʿalayhi arḥāmul-unthayayn, nabbiʾūnī biʿilmin in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلْإِبِلِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَمِنَ ٱلْبَقَرِ ٱثْنَيْنِ قُلْ ءَآلذَّكَرَيْنِ حَرَّمَ أَمِ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمَّا ٱشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ أَمْ كُنتُمْ شُهَدَآءَ إِذْ وَصَّىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا لِّيُضِلَّ ٱلنَّاسَ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (144) And of the camels, two and of the cattle, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Or were you witnesses when Allāh charged you with this? Then who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allāh to mislead the people by [something] other than knowledge? Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people."
